'''Bellata''' is a girl NPC who appears near a large fountain in [[City Square]], [[Rinascita]], at night.

After you interact with her, you will get some astrites and items.

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Bellata:''' I wonder... when will Dad return from the pilgrimage?
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Bellata:''' {{MC|m=Mister|f=Miss}}, take it. I don't need it anymore.
:{{DIcon}} What is this coin for?
:'''Bellata:''' Toss it into the well, it'll tell you if things will go well or not.
:'''Bellata:''' I've tried many times, but the results about Dad are always bad... When will he come home?
:{{DIcon}} What happened to your dad?
:'''Bellata:''' A few months ago, he boarded the great pilgrim ship to visit the Sentinel at sea.
:'''Bellata:''' Isn't this something to be proud of? Why does Mom always look so sad whenever she mentions it?
{{Dialogue End}}
